paragraphs.text: Grover was an Ironroot Treefolk who ran a tavern simply called Grover's , located somewhere in the Red Iron Mountains of Aerona , part of the Domains of Dominaria .

While Grover was not necessarily known for his great wisdom, he did have a soft spot for the adventurers who rested in his tavern and regularly offered his advice, comfort, and even provisions for those who needed them.
Grover's includes a wayhouse for travelers that tends to be fairly crowded. Grover doesn’t require guests to check their weapons, but he provides a place for them to be stored.

Grover's attracts diverse patrons, many of whom were abandoned by dueling planeswalkers . Known patrons of the bar include a Benalish Hero , an Argivian Archaeologist , Cat Warriors , dwarves , and a troop of Crookshank kobolds . Patrons known by name include Loot Niptil , Kyyrao Grrenmw , Shinra , Malkean Feorr , Sular and Corsen Mon Duur .

Grover's tavern attracted many wanderers, most of whom were refugees of planeswalker fights. Around 4000 AR , a bunch of Crookshank kobolds began frequenting Grover's and eating him out of everything. He told their leader, Dreadfang , that his brood had run out of credit and they needed to provide a service to the wayhouse, telling them to round up pirquelberries. The kobolds left and waylaid an incoming caravan, so Grover told his patrons it was last call until the kobolds were scattered. The spat temporarily ended when Kyyrao Grrenmw snapped Dreadfang's neck.

One year later, a reanimated Dreadfang captured Corsen Mon Duur 's family, sending him back to Grover's to convince Loot Niptil to join him on a trip to the Peregrinator Complex to seek out Anaytha , a woman who was rumored to resemble him closely. Loot was joined on this venture by Kyyrao Grrenmw and Shinra . Grover provided them with no words of wisdom, but did give them provisions for the trip.
